description.text: Program Description The major of international politics is to study the transnational interactive relations of international actors with the country as the main body, and then to study all the factors that influence such interaction mainly from the perspective of politics. International politics is about power, interest and security to get to know and study the international social evolution and the law of development, mainly explain the political role of political actors to each other and the evolution of the general law. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The International Politics at Tongji University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate, non-Chinese citizen 2. with Old HSK Band 3 or New HSK Band 4 for Medicine, Science and Engineering, Original certificate of Old HSK Band 6 or New HSK Band 5 (Total Score: over 180) for the program of Liberal Arts
